theme: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

reports.title: Stephen Coulson
categories: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

promises.quote: The policy was updated in November 2017 to include reference to an opioid patch monitoring form. The use of the form should minimise the risk of a similar incident experienced by Mr Coulson being repeated. The trust managers have informed the Commission that they plan to audit implementation of the form. We will monitor this through our quarterly engagement meetings and subsequently consider this at the next inspection, which is likely to take place between October and December 2018.
promises.summary: Audit implementation of opioid patch monitoring form

concerns.quote: the system in place for the administration, documentation and audit of processes associated with the use of controlled drugs
the lack of escalation of the need to admit patients for observation and review should they fulfil the criteria to require continued observation / review prior to discharge
the witness did not accept that any lessons could be learnt from the investigation surrounding the death of the deceased

reports.title: Michael Lobban
categories: Alcohol, drug and medication related deaths

concerns.quote: The investigation carried out by The Boots Company PLC into the disparity of Methadone tablets on this occasion was slow and efforts to contact patients who were regular prescription users of methadone was not fully followed through
concerns.hazard: delayed investigation of missing methadone tablets

concerns.quote: The audit checking of controlled drugs by The Boots Company PLC is not robust in that there is no double check in place in relation to the audit checking procedure followed by Boots
concerns.hazard: lack of double check in controlled drug audit

concerns.quote: There appears to be no physical check of the contents of prescription boxes when carrying out the audit of schedule 2 controlled drugs
concerns.hazard: absence of physical verification of prescription contents

concerns.quote: The General Pharmaceutical Council ("The Council") being the Regulator of Pharmaceutical industry in England and Wales does not have any reporting requirements for pharmacies when discovering a discrepancy in schedule 2 controlled drugs
concerns.hazard: lack of reporting requirements for schedule 2 drug discrepancies

concerns.quote: Moreover there appear to be no investigative powers by The Council where it discovers a disparity of these controlled drugs and as a consequence there are no sanctions in circumstances where pharmacies have mislaid drugs during the course of their handling of controlled drugs
concerns.hazard: absence of investigative powers and sanctions for pharmacies
